disclaimer: Named ancient or historical individuals with public genotype data when present in AADR. Royal Egyptian pharaohs and Achaemenid kings do not have released genomes.
missing_royals: No published genomes from Achaemenid kings (Cyrus, Darius, Xerxes).
Tutankhamun-family and Ramesses III studies used STR fingerprints; full genomes were not released.
Closest useful references are anonymous ancient Egyptians, Iranians, and other AADR groups — not named kings.
